texts: Play a solo game, race a friend, or climb the competition leaderboard.
DEVNET · TEST TOKENS · NO CASH VALUE
SOLO Play classic A quiet game. Pause whenever you want.
FREE Practice No wallet required. Same grid, two players.
LEADERBOARD Compete Free rooms: join with a wallet message, then Start. Fastest correct finish ranks.

phases.name: OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED
phases.instruction:
On the Seeker NOW:
1) Open Seed Vault / Solana Mobile Wallet and SWITCH to a DIFFERENT owner account (not E3DQ…).
2) Return to Soldoku.
3) Tap Connect wallet → Mobile Wallet Adapter → approve CONNECT (PIN/biometrics).
Do NOT clear Soldoku storage. Tell the chat when the new wallet chip shows on Home (or just approve — script is watching).
